The game's music, ambience and sound effects use 371 source files by 24 authors, all released under [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (public domain dedication). CC0 requires no attribution; these credits are given with thanks and as a provenance record. Theme layers marked "derived" are filtered variants of a credited track made by the audio pipeline; derived sound-effect variants are pitch-shifted copies.
